# Voices

Ask a question|Copy page|[View as Markdown](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/voices.md "View this page as plain text")|More actions

This page is for Model APIs.

Listen to every voice before you pick one for your product. Each sample below reads the same expressive line, **“वाह, यह तो कमाल है! Sarvam AI के साथ अपनी भाषा में बात करना अब बहुत आसान हो गया है।”** (“Wow, this is amazing! Talking in your own language with Sarvam AI has become so easy now.”), so you can compare voices directly and hear how each one handles natural emotion and prosody. Use the `speaker` parameter to select any of these in your API calls; see [How to change the speaker voice](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/how-to/change-the-speaker-voice) for code samples.

Want to test your own text? Head to [dashboard.sarvam.ai](https://dashboard.sarvam.ai/text-to-speech) to generate live previews with custom input.

Not sure which voice to pick? [Bulbul v4 Flash best practices](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/best-practices#recommended-voices-by-use-case) lists expert-ranked personas for English and Hindi by use case.

Need a voice that isn’t in this list? The [Instant Voice Cloning API](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/voice-cloning/overview) (beta) generates speech in a cloned voice from a short reference clip, or in a saved voice via `voice_id` — usable from the same SDK alongside these speakers.

## Bulbul v4 Flash Voices

`bulbul:v4-flash` uses the same request and response contract as `bulbul:v3`: pass `model="bulbul:v4-flash"` with one of the `speaker` values below (or omit `speaker` to use the default persona **`shubh_enhi_ads`**). The catalog is organized by persona rather than a flat name list. Most voice IDs follow `<name>_<language>_<style>` (for example `ishita_hi_devotional`, `simran_en_customer`). The middle token is a short language tag (`hi`, `en`, `bn`, …) or **`enhi`** for English–Hindi code-mixed personas.

**Languages in this catalog (222 voices):** Hindi, English, English–Hindi (`enhi`), Bengali, Gujarati, Kannada, Marathi, Punjabi, Tamil, and Telugu — mapped at request time with the usual BCP-47 `language_code` values (`hi-IN`, `en-IN`, and so on). **Bulbul v3** still covers the full [11-language set](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/voices#hear-voices-across-languages) (including Malayalam and Odia); v4 Flash personas are not offered for every v3 language yet.

Speaker names are case-sensitive and must be lowercase, exactly as shown in the tables below.

### Featured voices

Start here if you are unsure which persona to pick. These 11 voices are hand-picked for the most common production use cases. Filter by use case, copy the exact `speaker` value, or grab a ready-to-run snippet.

Bulbul v3 supports 11 languages, and voice quality varies by language. Below, two of our top-rated speakers, **shubh** (male) and **ishita** (female), read the same localized line in each supported language, translated with [Sarvam Translate](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-processing/translation).

English · en-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Hindi · hi-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Bengali · bn-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Tamil · ta-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Telugu · te-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Kannada · kn-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Malayalam · ml-IN

shubh (male)

ishita (female)

Punjabi · pa-IN

ishita (female)

Odia · od-IN

ishita (female)

For **v4 Flash** , start from the [use-case voice rankings](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/best-practices#recommended-voices-by-use-case). For **v3** short names, see [Bulbul v3 best practices](https://docs.sarvam.ai/api/api-guides-tutorials/text-to-speech/bulbul-v3-best-practices#speaker-selection-by-language).

## Generate Your Own Sample

###### Python

###### cURL
    
    
    from sarvamai import SarvamAI
    
    from sarvamai.play import save
    
    client = SarvamAI(api_subscription_key="YOUR_SARVAM_API_KEY")
    
    audio = client.text_to_speech.convert(
    
        text="वाह, यह तो कमाल है! Sarvam AI के साथ अपनी भाषा में बात करना अब बहुत आसान हो गया है।",
    
        model="bulbul:v4-flash",
    
        language_code="hi-IN",
    
        speaker="ishita_hi_ads"
    
    )
    
    save(audio, "preview.wav")
